notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
When the Spirit creature token enters, the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from Step 1.
Repeat.
